rooms.name: Room 101 - President Office
rooms.workDescription: Executive leadership, strategic university planning, international partnerships, and institutional governance.

rooms.name: Room 102 - Registrar Office
rooms.workDescription: Student course registration, official transcript requests, degree verifications, and student ID card issuing.

rooms.name: Room 201 - Finance & Payroll
rooms.workDescription: Tuition fee processing, staff payroll management, research grant disbursements, and budget auditing.

rooms.name: Room 202 - Human Resources
rooms.workDescription: Faculty recruitment, academic staff accreditation, employee benefits, and staff welfare.

details.description: Block 1 serves as the central administrative nervous system of Addis Ababa Science and Technology University (ASTU). Established to coordinate institutional operations, it houses the Office of the University President, Academic Vice President, Student Affairs Registrar, and Financial Directorate. All official university documentation, student admissions, graduation clearances, and international academic collaborations are managed in this building.
details.history: Constructed during the initial phase of ASTU's campus expansion in 2011, Block 1 stands at the central north plaza directly facing the Main Gate.
details.hours: Mon - Fri: 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM (Lunch Break: 12:30 PM - 1:30 PM)

rooms.name: Room G-01 - Power Systems & High Voltage Lab
rooms.workDescription: Testing high voltage transformers, electrical power grid simulation, motor control drives, and renewable energy grid integration.

rooms.name: Room 105 - Embedded Systems & Hardware Lab
rooms.workDescription: Microcontroller programming (ARM, AVR, ESP32), FPGA logic synthesis, PCB circuit design, and Internet of Things (IoT) hardware debugging.

rooms.name: Room 204 - Advanced Computer Engineering Lab
rooms.workDescription: Undergraduate & postgraduate lectures in Computer Architecture, VLSI Design, Digital Signal Processing, and Embedded Operating Systems.

rooms.name: Room 301 - Telecommunications & Microwave Antenna Lab
rooms.workDescription: Wireless signal propagation modeling, RF antenna design, fiber optic communication testing, and 5G network research.

details.description: Block 7 is the dedicated academic building for the Department of Electrical and Computer Engineering (ECE). The building spans 4 floors equipped with cutting-edge engineering research laboratories, high-voltage test bays, embedded systems development hardware, and telecommunications research equipment.
details.history: Upgraded in 2018 under the Ethiopian National Center of Excellence Initiative to provide state-of-the-art STEM hardware design facilities.

rooms.name: Room 101 - Materials & Concrete Testing Lab
rooms.workDescription: Stress-strain testing of concrete cubes, soil mechanics analysis, structural beam loading tests, and asphalt quality verification.

rooms.name: Room 201 - Software Development Studio
rooms.workDescription: Full-stack web application development, mobile app lab, Agile sprint team practice, and cloud computing workshops.

rooms.name: Room 301 - Artificial Intelligence & Computer Vision Hub
rooms.workDescription: Deep learning model training, natural language processing for Amharic/Oromo languages, computer vision for drone navigation, and robotics control.

details.description: Block 8 houses the dual disciplines of Software Engineering and Civil Engineering. It features software innovation incubators on the upper floors and heavy civil structural testing equipment on the ground floor.

rooms.name: Ground Floor - Silent Main Reading Hall
rooms.workDescription: Strict silent self-study area for undergraduate and graduate students with individual study cubicles and reference textbook stacks.

rooms.name: 1st Floor - E-Learning Center & IEEE Digital Hub
rooms.workDescription: 200+ desktop PCs providing direct online access to IEEE Xplore, ScienceDirect, Springer, digital theses repository, and fast research printing.

rooms.name: 2nd Floor - Postgraduate Research & Collaborative Study Rooms
rooms.workDescription: Group discussion rooms for senior capstone project teams, Master's degree thesis preparation, and faculty research meetings.

details.description: The ASTU Central Library is a 3-story landmark knowledge center holding over 60,000 printed engineering and natural science textbooks alongside subscriptions to global digital academic journals. It offers quiet study environments, desktop computer suites, high-speed campus internet, and digital archival services.
details.headOfDepartment: Ato Biruk M. (Director of Library Services)

rooms.name: Ground Floor - Main Student Dining Hall
rooms.workDescription: Serving fresh daily traditional Ethiopian meals (Injera, Wot) and international dishes to regular campus students.

rooms.name: 1st Floor - Staff & Faculty Lounge & Coffee Bar
rooms.workDescription: Dedicated dining room and traditional Ethiopian coffee ceremony bar for ASTU academic faculty and administrative staff.

details.description: The main campus dining facility capable of catering for over 4,000 students daily across scheduled breakfast, lunch, and dinner shifts.
details.hours: Daily: 6:30 AM - 8:30 PM (Breakfast: 6:30-8:00 AM, Lunch: 11:30 AM-1:30 PM, Dinner: 5:30-7:30 PM)
